fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) is trading at $380 and would need a 58% gain to reach $600, but the Wall Street average target price is only $412.48, implying 9% upside.
fields.summary_ko.1: FSD subscriptions reached 1.74M and robotaxi revenue is expected to materialize in Q3-Q4 next year, but R&D surged, causing Q3 operating income to decline 56%, with consensus estimates being revised downward.
